description: Twelve unchanged original POSIX guest filesystem bridge cases on macOS, not WSL runtime acceptance.
sourceVitestConfigDifferencesFromCapsule: Use original installed Vitest4.1.11 with Node24; no dependency installation or original-tree writes.

Minimal node config omits original renderer aliases, feature-wall define, DOM/host-port setup, execArgv, broader include and extended timeouts. This reviewed closure uses none of those app facilities; no full configuration/typecheck equivalence claimed.
Original suite skips win32. This macOS run cannot prove Linux guest execution, Windows host integration, WSL installation or transport behavior.
isolationRationale: Full test, bridge and shared contract bodies read. Type-only dispatcher imports erased. Real files and directories created only under per-case mkdtemp homes and cleaned by original afterEach. Read-only readdir probes on temporary-home ancestor and /; names are not printed. Reviewed lexical checks reject outside writes/renames/mkdir before fs calls. No relay process, WSL command, network, model or real home configuration. This is NOT a pure-function capsule or filesystem sandbox: inside-home symlinks are followed by source design; no such symlinks are created here.
testEvidenceBoundary: Twelve original cases unchanged. No successful rename/unlink/chmod/stat handler coverage, complete registration-set assertion, symlink behavior assertion, wire errors, real guest process or candidate parity.
